related.title: 重力波干涉儀懸吊
related.transfer: 可遷移「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」與「傳遞率與柔度的量測方法」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；重力波干涉儀懸吊的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" and "Measuring transmissibility and compliance" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦傳遞率、氣墊隔振腳、蜂巢桌面柔度、VC 樓板準則與熱聲漂移預算；重力波干涉儀懸吊則以四級擺懸吊的隔振傳遞函數、熔融石英纖維熱雜訊與阻尼控制工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on transmissibility, pneumatic legs, honeycomb compliance, VC floor criteria and thermal-acoustic drift budgets; Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions centres on isolation transfer function of quadruple-pendulum suspensions, fused-silica fibre thermal noise and damping-control engineering, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「單自由度隔振器」與「地面震動與測試質量」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到重力波干涉儀懸吊，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Single-degree-of-freedom isolator” and “Ground motion and the test mass”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Noise budget and the sensitivity curve", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 無振動精密實驗平台
history.text: 1960 年代雷射與全像術出現後，干涉實驗需要次波長級穩定，早期實驗室使用花崗岩板、沙箱或充氣內胎；隨後鋼製蜂巢桌面與氣墊隔振腳商品化，成為光學實驗室的標準配備。1991 年 Colin Gordon 提出通用振動準則 VC 曲線，讓半導體廠與奈米實驗室能以 rms 速度頻譜規範樓板；1990 年代起主動隔振普及到電子顯微鏡與微影設備，Advanced LIGO 更以多級主動平台搭配四段擺，把地面運動壓低多個數量級。本課只重建公開物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: After lasers and holography appeared in the 1960s, interference experiments needed sub-wavelength stability, and early laboratories used granite slabs, sand tables or inflated inner tubes; steel honeycomb tops and pneumatic legs were then commercialized and became standard optical-laboratory equipment. In 1991 Colin Gordon proposed the generic vibration criteria, the VC curves, letting semiconductor fabs and nanotechnology laboratories specify floors as rms velocity spectra; from the 1990s active isolation spread to electron microscopes and lithography tools, and Advanced LIGO combines multi-stage active platforms with quadruple pendulums to suppress ground motion by many orders of magnitude. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「傳遞率、自然頻率與阻尼取捨」到「現場安裝、振動短路與驗收交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Transmissibility, natural frequency and the damping trade-off" through "Site installation, vibration short circuits and acceptance handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
